summary: Checked all 56 requested estimates plus the paper-level supplement changes (57 entries). Read all 522 main-paper markdown lines, all 2507 Supplement 1 lines and all 243 Supplement 2 lines, including appendices and references; opened every cited source page and recovered Tables 1-3 with pymupdf. Found nine omissions of the explicitly printed 200-person human sample in newly added Experiment 2B estimates. All recorded effect statistics, arm summaries, signs, confidence limits and p-values match their cited analyses. The 650-cell table comparison found only three already documented main/supplement differences: the two rounded expert creativity p-values and the Experiment 2B expert creativity t statistic. The main-text values were correctly preserved; no pre-existing numeric value is replaced in supplement_changes. Scientific-notation, subscript and selected-table-cell quote warnings are matching artifacts, not numerical transcription errors. The other checked codes and contrasts are supported, including lay coding of Table 2 despite its misleading title, rating-based uncertainty for the novelty categories, and the explicitly pooled factorial contrasts. The combined 300-response Experiment 2B model count is distinguished from the 200 human participants; per-arm counts remain unreported. Known source inconsistencies in expert t statistics and the unresolved top-ranked-share denominator remain documented rather than repaired by calculation. Supplement 2 text exactly matches the Reporting Summary appended to the main PDF.
